Install Solaris

このコンテンツはまだ日本語訳がありません。

Solaris V2 is a Vue application built with Vite. To run it locally, follow the GitHub installation steps below. The project is also published as solaris-v2 on npm.

Online Preview

Want to preview the code in your browser? Visit our GitHub repo to look through the code, without ever leaving your browser.

Requirements

Section titled “Requirements”
  • Node.js - Version 20.19.0 or later in the 20.x series, or 22.12.0 or later, as specified by the package.
  • Git - Required to clone the repository.
  • Package manager - npm, pnpm, or Yarn.
  • Terminal - Required to run the commands below.
  • Text editor - We recommend VS Code or JetBrains.

Install from GitHub

Section titled “Install from GitHub”

Follow these steps to download Solaris V2 and start it on your machine.

  1. Clone the Solaris V2 repository.

  2. Change into the project directory.

  3. Install the project dependencies.

    • npm
    • pnpm
    • Yarn

  4. Start the development server.

    • npm
    • pnpm
    • Yarn

    Open the local URL printed by Vite in your browser.

Build for deployment

Section titled “Build for deployment”

Create an optimized production build with:

  • npm
  • pnpm
  • Yarn

To preview the production build locally, run:

  • npm
  • pnpm
  • Yarn
